infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Rooka requires camera access to capture physique check-in photos and coach avatars.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Rooka requires microphone access for voice coaching notes and audio logs.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Rooka requires photo library access to choose workout and progress photos.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Rooka requires location access to track outdoor running, cycling, and GPS activity routes.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Rooka needs access to read your workouts, heart rate, and activity metrics.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Rooka needs permission to save scheduled workouts to your Apple Watch and Apple Health.
